title: Avoiding finitely many linear subspaces
statement:
Let $k$ be an infinite field, let $V$ be a finite-dimensional
$k$-vector space, and let $W_1,\ldots,W_s$ be proper linear
subspaces. Then $V\ne\bigcup_{j=1}^s W_j$.
